title: Ridgeline Installation Services Final Settlement Payment by Bank Card
content:
This rule fixes the final settlement payment a customer makes on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract whose status is completed, charged to the customer's own bank card.

## When the amount is worked out

The final settlement payment is worked out only after every customer reschedule recorded on the contract carries the reschedule fee line owed for it.

Put the other way round, the same clause reads: while a customer reschedule recorded on the contract stands without the reschedule fee line owed for it, the final settlement payment is not yet worked out.

## Contract and tender

- The contract's status, as the contract record shows it, is completed.
- The payment is charged to the customer's own bank card.

## Invocation

The payment is made with `pay_final_balance_37ea441b`, a tool the customer runs for themselves. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the charge to their own bank card. One run records one payment toward that contract, dated today, with tender bank card and purpose final payment, and lowers the contract's balance due by the amount paid; the customer receives a payment confirmation and sees the lower balance due.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract being paid, as given to the customer by the agent from the installation contract lookup | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `payment_amount` | the amount charged to the customer's bank card, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the payment line), `install_contract_id` (the contract paid), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `payment_method` (always `bank_card`), `payment_purpose` (always `final_payment`), `amount` (the amount charged, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's payment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the payment, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the payment is recorded.
